text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch fo their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting
- Cabinet says eruption of clashes in West Bank and Gaza Strip are indication of the failure of peace moves with Israel
- Cabinet says practice of usury is forbidden in our society
- Cabinet urges Arabs to change attitude towards Iraq which represents a strong base for the nation in face of challenges
- Foreign minister discussed oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- World concerned about human rights violations in Turkey
- Turkish party and a British organisation denounce Ankara's plans for the creation of security zone in northern Iraq
- Labour and social affairs minister meets Romanian ambassador
- Washington rejects draft resolution at U.N. Security Council to denounce Israeli repression of Palestinians
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Editorial calls on the Palestinians to remain steadfast in rejection of Israeli plans
